craft_notes: Sthāyin: whole time in breath. Rows: catalogue then count. Read aloud: counting chant.

lines: whole time is told out in breath.
Bean-and-fifth the measure — hence dawns the clock;
sixty beans the clock, seventy-two long.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra ghaṭikā tithiḥ māso varṣaṃ ca varṣasamūhātmā iti samastaḥ kālaḥ parisamāpyate tatra sapañcāṃśe aṅgule caṣaka iti sthityā ghaṭikodayaḥ ghaṭikā hi ṣaṣṭyā caṣakaiḥ tasmāt dvāsaptatyaṅgulā bhavati
